title: A trial's test shards run on two hosts and report one result
description: A merge trial on a repository with a second host named in run.hosts: the commit is pushed to that host's mirror over SSH, the trial image and warm dependency image are made ready there, and the trial's shards run on both this machine and that host through the trial launcher. The trial reports one combined result with every file's records, and master status shows the share of shards run remotely, trial wall time, waits while a host idled, this machine's peak CPU temperature and each host's state.

steps.name: a two-host trial runs its shards on both and master status reports them
